title: Te wairangi o te wawata nui
intro: Tīmatahia he haerenga ki te hura i te tuakiri o tētahi rōpū i tutuki ai ā rātou mahere maia ki tētahi mutunga ohorere, kaha hoki. He whakamahara hohonu tēnei kōrero mō te mana atua me te ngoikore o te mana o te ao ina whakahē ana i te tapu. Wetekina te mea ngaro o tēnei rōpū, ko tana kōrero kua whakairohia i roto i te Quran hei whakatūpato mō te hunga katoa e whai ana ki te takahi i te ture.
clues: I puritia e mātou he wawata nui, me te whakapono kāore he rite o tō mātou kaha, ā, ka tīmata mātou i tētahi haerenga me tētahi whāinga mārama, whakangaro hoki.
I te whakapehapeha, i whai tō mātou rangatira ki te whakapoke i tētahi Whare tapu e whakanuia ana e te tini, me te whai kia tahuri te haerenga mai ki tētahi whare i hangaia e mātou.
Mai i tawhiti, i haere tahi mātou me tētahi ope nui, me te whakapono ki tō mātou kaha ki te whakahoro i te whare tawhito i te Tāone Tapu.
He tino kaha tō mātou ope taua, he mea ārahi e ngā mea whakamiharo, he mea onge, mēnā kāore anō kia kitea, i roto i tētahi pakanga pēnei e ngā tāngata o te whenua i whakaekea e mātou.
I tō mātou taenga ki tō mātou ūnga, ka puta mai te awhina a te Atua; ka puta mai ngā mea ririki whai parirau, e whiu ana i a mātou ki ngā kōhatu paru tunua.
I mutu kino rawa tā mātou haerenga katoa, ā, i ngaro rawa atu tō mātou ope nui, pērā i te kakau witi e ngaungauhia ana, ā, i memeha haere tā mātou mahere nui.

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verse: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? (105:1)
